name: STDEV
description: STDEV estimates the standard deviation based on a sample of a population, using the n-1 denominator (Bessel's correction). It is the legacy compatibility version of STDEV.S.
tldr: Sample standard deviation (n-1) of a set of numbers.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, range, or reference in the sample.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Additional numbers, ranges, or references (optional, up to 255 total arguments).

basicExample.description: Sample standard deviation of five values
basicExample.explanation: The mean is 30; the sample variance is 250 (sum of squared deviations 1000 divided by 5-1) and its square root is 15.8113883.

advancedExamples.title: Sample from a range
advancedExamples.scenario: Measuring spread of a production sample
advancedExamples.description: Compute the standard deviation of weights recorded in A2:A11
advancedExamples.result: Sample standard deviation of the 10 values
advancedExamples.explanation: Uses the 10 sampled values with n-1 (that is, 9) in the denominator.

advancedExamples.title: Sample vs population
advancedExamples.explanation: STDEV divides by 4 (n-1) while STDEVP divides by 5 (n), so the population version is smaller.

howItWorks: STDEV computes the sample variance as the sum of squared deviations from the mean divided by (n-1), then takes the square root. The n-1 divisor (Bessel's correction) produces an unbiased estimate of the population standard deviation when only a sample is available. Text and logical values contained in ranged references are ignored.

howToSteps.name: Select sample
howToSteps.text: Gather the numeric sample values in cells or as arguments.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The sample standard deviation is displayed.

limitations: Assumes the data is a sample, not the entire population; use STDEVP for a whole population.
Ignores text and logical values inside ranged references, so the count of values may be smaller than the cell count.
Requires at least two numeric values, otherwise it returns #DIV/0!.

commonErrors.cause: Fewer than two numeric values were supplied.
commonErrors.fix: Provide at least two data points.

commonErrors.cause: The data actually represents the full population but n-1 was used.
commonErrors.fix: Use STDEVP (or STDEV.P) when you have the entire population.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: STDEV behaves the same in Google Sheets as a sample standard deviation.

faq.question: What is the difference between STDEV and STDEVP?
faq.answer: STDEV divides by n-1 (sample), STDEVP divides by n (population).

faq.question: Is STDEV the same as STDEV.S?
faq.answer: Functionally yes; STDEV.S is the modern replacement for the legacy STDEV function.

faq.question: Does STDEV include text in cells?
faq.answer: No. Use STDEVA if you want text counted as 0 and TRUE counted as 1.
